item.title: PulseSoul is out.
item.description:
PulseSoul is out.
CareShield is the part I am proudest of: if a family member's phone goes quiet, it checks on them gently before it ever involves you. Optional, and never an alarm.
On Google Play now.
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pulsesoul.app
#buildinpublic #indiedev #androiddevelopment

item.title: They don't want much. Just a call.
item.description:

Free on Google Play.

item.title: Not watching. Just there if it's quiet.
item.description:
Not watching. Just there if it's quiet.
CareShield asks a parent's phone first, gently. It nudges you only if the quiet continues. Optional, and never an alarm. It is not a medical or health device.
PulseSoul is free on Google Play.
Image created with AI.
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pulsesoul.app
#buildinpublic #indiedev #androiddevelopment

item.title: Some laughs are worth keeping.
item.description:
Some laughs are worth keeping.
A group chat is where photos go to disappear. Family Moments is a private album inside PulseSoul — no strangers, no likes, no algorithm. Just the people who were there.
Free on Google Play.

item.title: Streaks, filters, custom themes, voice effects.
item.description:
Streaks, filters, custom themes, voice effects.
The apps your kids use charge for most of that. In PulseSoul it is all free, permanently, because a family app should not have a paywall between a father and his daughter.
Looking for 12 testers before launch. Comment IN.
https://pulsesoul.app
#buildinpublic #indiedev #androiddevelopment

item.title: I built a messaging app for families and it is nearly ready.
item.description:
I built a messaging app for families and it is nearly ready.
Before Google will let PulseSoul onto the Play Store, 12 real people have to test it for 14 days straight. That is the rule.
So: 12 seats. You get the app early, I get the feedback, everyone wins. Comment IN and I will send you the link.
https://pulsesoul.app
#buildinpublic #indiedev #androiddevelopment

item.title: Last call for the tester group.
item.description:
Last call for the tester group.

Comment IN.
https://pulsesoul.app
#buildinpublic #indiedev #androiddevelopment
